sections.heading: Overview
sections.content: Monthly Revenue is calculated by aggregating all confirmed sales orders within a calendar month. The revenue is recognized at the point of order confirmation.

sections.heading: Net Revenue Calculation
sections.content: Net Revenue is calculated as Gross Revenue minus refunds, discounts, and chargebacks. Specifically: Net Revenue = Gross Revenue - SUM(refund_amount) - SUM(discount_amount) - SUM(chargeback_amount). This calculation is performed at month-end closing.

sections.heading: Data Sources
sections.content: The primary data source for Monthly Revenue is the sales.orders table in Snowflake. Payment adjustments are sourced from the raw.payments table. Both datasets are joined on order_id.

sections.heading: Reporting Schedule
sections.content: Monthly Revenue reports are generated on the first business day of each month. The report is available on the Monthly Revenue dashboard in Mode.
